entities.summary: Myanmar is a sovereign nation in Southeast Asia, Asia. Its capital is Naypyidaw (since 2006). Official languages include Burmese. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic under military junta (since 2021). Population: approximately 54.6 million. Area: 676,578 km². Comprehensive index for Myanmar covering Pyu city-states, Mon Dvaravati, Pagan Empire (1044-1287, Theravada Buddhism), Mongol invasions, Shan states, Toungoo Dynasty, Konbaung Dynasty (Mandalay), Anglo-Burmese Wars (1824-1885), British colonial rule, Aung San independence movement, WWII Japanese occupation, independence 1948, civil wars (Karen, Shan, Kachin), socialist Ne Win era, 8888 uprising, SLORC junta, Saffron Revolution 2007, Cyclone Nargis 2008, democratic opening (2011-2021), Rohingya genocide, and February 2021 military coup.
